title: repo.json
description: An open repository metadata file: what a repository is and how it should be presented. See https://repos-json.github.io/repos-json/spec/
$comment: Advisory, not normative. The specification requires a consumer to IGNORE an invalid value rather than reject the document (spec section 11.2), so a failure here is a lint result and never a parse result. Unknown keys are allowed everywhere on purpose: today's unknown key is tomorrow's field, or another tool's extension.

$schema.description: Reserved for editor tooling. Consumers ignore it.

projects.description: The units this repository contains. A string is shorthand for a one-entry array, and a string entry for { "path": <string> }. See spec section 9.

identity.$comment: Everything a repo.json says about one unit. Shared verbatim by the document and by each projects[] entry, which is the specification's rule that an entry IS a repo.json document with a path (section 9.1).

name.description: Display name — what a human should see, not necessarily the directory or package name.

description.description: One line. What the project is, not how to install it.

icon.description: The project's mark. A string is shorthand for a one-entry array: "x.png" means [{ "src": "x.png" }].

color.description: Brand colour. A string is shorthand for the primary role: "#7c3aed" means { "primary": "#7c3aed" }.

homepage.description: An absolute http or https URL.

authors.description: Free-form; "Name <email>" is conventional but not required.

extensions.description: Tool-specific settings, keyed by a name the writer owns. Contents are defined by that tool alone.

projectEntry.description: One unit of this repository: a repo.json document with a path.
projectEntry.$comment: `projects: false` forbids the property outright: an entry may not nest inline, because nesting is expressed by the nested directory's own repo.json (spec section 9.1).

then.$comment: A wildcard entry stands for many directories and cannot name one, so the identity fields are forbidden on it (spec section 9.2).

projectPath.description: A repository-relative directory. "." is the repository root; a path segment of "*" matches one directory name.
projectPath.$comment: Never remote and never inline, so a URL scheme is rejected here where icon.src accepts one. Containment cannot be checked in a schema: it depends on normalising '..' against the repository root.

iconSrc.$comment: A path relative to repo.json, or an absolute http(s) or data: URL. Containment (spec section 6) cannot be checked here: it depends on the repository root and on normalising '..', so it is the consumer's job.
iconSrc.description: A path relative to this file, or an absolute http(s) or data: URL.

type.description: MIME type. A hint only — a wrong or absent type never disqualifies an icon.

color.description: #rgb or #rrggbb, case-insensitive. No other CSS colour syntax.

colorRoles.$comment: Additional properties are allowed rather than forbidden: color.dark is reserved for a future version, and rejecting it here would make a forward-looking file look broken.
